---
title: "Raw HTML"
format:
  emiljs:
    keep-emiljs: true
jupyter: python3
_quarto:
  tests:
    emiljs:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: []
      ensureHtmlElements:
        # the blank lines inside the block did not end it or turn into &#10;
        - ['div.w b', 'span.inline', 'div.ticks code']
      ensureEmiljsFileRegexMatches:
        # a block becomes a `{=html}` fence; one holding backticks gets a longer fence
        - ['\n```\{=html\}\n<div class="w">\n\n<b>blank lines</b>\n\n</div>\n```\n', '\n````\{=html\}\n<div class="ticks"><code>```</code></div>\n````\n', 'with <span class="inline">inline html</span>']
        # no entity-encoded newlines, and no inline `<tag>`{=html} wrapper
        - ['&#10;', '>`\{=html\}']
---

Before.

```{python}
#| echo: false
from IPython.display import HTML
HTML('<div class="w">\n\n<b>blank lines</b>\n\n</div>')
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
HTML('<div class="ticks"><code>```</code></div>')
```

After, with <span class="inline">inline html</span>.
